name: Trace a claim to its source
short_description: Follow one cited claim to its original source and compare the source with the later wording.
self_assessment: I can trace one cited claim to its original source without help and note any change in meaning.
description: Follow one cited claim to its original source and compare the source with the later wording. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Trace a quoted statistic to its originating report
